L1 - Multi-GPU Workloads + Targets (GPU-initiated RMA - fine-grained overlap - scale-up today)
L2 - Programming Model (PGAS symmetric heap - GPU-initiated comm - vs RCCL bulk-synchronous)
CPU-initiated control - separate compute + comm kernels
Host-device sync barriers - operator-level overlap only
GPU-initiated RMA - comm starts when data produced
No intermediate buffers - direct to application memory
Collective alloc - all_gather heap base per rank
Few 100 lines core - no heavyweight runtime
L3 - Host API (Python PyTorch-like - identical across Triton and Gluon backends)
Create Iris context w/ symmetric heap (e.g. 1GiB)
ctx.zeros() / tensor alloc on symmetric heap
torch.distributed NCCL init for process group
Fused GEMM + CCL ops in iris.ops
load store copy get put - RMA ops
sem acquire/release scope gpu/sys for locks
L4 - Overlap Pattern Taxonomy (GEMM + All-Scatter representative - up to 2.5x vs bulk sync)
Single kernel: compute tile then scatter
Data stays in registers - no HBM roundtrip
Single kernel - WG as producer or consumer
Best perf - up to 60pct over unfused P-C
Future - not yet in std Triton
L5 - Runtime Stack (Triton compile path + HIP P2P/XGMI - host orchestration minimal)
iris.* ops lowered inline - no separate comm lib
Cross-GPU load/store via peer mapping + XGMI
Full scale-up on single node today
L6 - Package Layout (iris/ - host/ - mem/triton/ - mem/gluon/ - examples/ - benchmark/ - docs/)
Single uber-kernel - producer WGs compute - consumer WGs scatter via iris RMA
Step 1: Host init torch.distributed + iris.iris(heap) + symmetric tensor alloc
Step 2: Launch fused @triton.jit - if pid less num_gem_cus: producer WG else consumer WG
Step 3: Producer computes GEMM tile - atomic_cas release lock - tile ready signal
Step 4: Consumer spin acquire lock - iris.load remote tile - iris.store scatter to peers
Step 5: __translate ptr via heap_bases - HIP P2P remote access - no RCCL call
Result: comm overlaps compute at tile granularity - up to 2.5x unfused - 60pct vs dual-stream P-C
GPU partition e.g. 256 CUs compute + 48 CUs comm in unfused producer-consumer variant
Multi-GPU as first-class Triton citizen - explore patterns not prescribe one approach

Design Position (GPU-initiated SHMEM RMA in Triton - low-level APIs for overlap pattern exploration)
Symmetric heap + device load/store/atomic + fused WG specialization = eliminate multi-GPU performance taxes
Init: dist.init_process_group + iris.iris(heap) + ctx.zeros - pass get_heap_bases() to @triton.jit kernel
Loop: compute tile - atomic release - iris.store/load RMA - consumer acquire - scatter - ctx.barrier
